title: Team Lead-Recruitment
description:
**Job Summary**
 We are seeking an experienced and result\-oriented
 **Lead Recruiter** 
 to lead and manage end\-to\-end recruitment activities across
 **IT and Non\-IT functions** 
 . The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in corporate hiring, sourcing strategy, stakeholder management, candidate assessment, and recruitment operations.
   

  

 The Lead Recruiter will be responsible for independently managing critical requirements, partnering with hiring managers, driving the recruitment team toward hiring targets, and ensuring timely closure of positions while maintaining a strong candidate experience.
   

  

**Key Roles And Responsibilities**
* Lead and manage the end\-to\-end recruitment lifecycle, from understanding requirements and sourcing to screening, interviewing, offer management, and joining.
* Partner closely with hiring managers and business stakeholders to understand manpower requirements, define hiring strategies, and ensure timely closure of positions.
* Lead recruitment for IT and Non\-IT roles across various skill sets and functions.
* Develop effective sourcing strategies using job portals, LinkedIn, social media, networking, referrals, internal databases, and other relevant channels.
* Handle targeted/market\-based hiring and talent mapping for critical and niche positions.
* Screen and evaluate candidates based on technical skills, experience, communication, cultural fit, and organizational requirements.
* Conduct initial interviews and coordinate subsequent interview rounds with hiring managers and stakeholders.
* Build strong relationships with candidates and provide a professional, high\-touch candidate experience throughout the recruitment process.
* Review and coordinate the collection of educational, employment, identity, and other required documents for background verification.
* Ensure complete and accurate documentation is submitted to the HR/BGV team within defined timelines.
* Maintain and monitor recruitment MIS, dashboards, hiring trackers, and recruitment reports.
* Track key recruitment metrics such as Time to Submit, Time to Hire, Submission\-to\-Interview, Interview\-to\-Selection, Offer\-to\-Joining, and overall hiring conversion ratios.
* Identify recruitment bottlenecks and proactively work with the Manager and stakeholders to develop effective solutions.
* Ensure recruitment SLAs and hiring targets are consistently achieved.
* Conduct regular follow\-ups with candidates and stakeholders to minimize offer dropouts and joining delays.
* Stay updated on market trends, talent availability, compensation trends, sourcing techniques, and emerging recruitment practices.
* Participate in daily recruitment reviews with the reporting manager and provide updates on hiring progress, challenges, and action plans.
* Take ownership of critical and high\-priority positions and drive them toward closure within defined timelines.


**Qualifications \& Skills**
* Experience: 6–8 years in Corporate/IT Recruitment, preferably in a Lead Recruiter role.
* Strong experience in end\-to\-end recruitment, stakeholder management, and multiple\-position hiring.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong sourcing, screening, interviewing, negotiation, and candidate management skills.
* Proficient in job portals, LinkedIn, ATS, MS Excel, PowerPoint, and recruitment tools.
* Good knowledge of recruitment MIS, hiring metrics, and analytics.
* Strong leadership, coordination, problem\-solving, and time\-management skills.
* Ability to guide junior recruiters and drive recruitment targets.
* Proactive, self\-driven, detail\-oriented, and accountable for hiring outcomes.
* Education: Bachelor's degree; MBA/PGDM in HR preferred.

 Evara is a fast\-growing Indian fashion brand focused on modern, feminine and accessible ethnic wear for women.
 



 As we continue to scale, we are looking for an
 **HR \& People Operations Manager** 
 who can take ownership of our people function and build a structured, high\-performance workplace.
 



 This is a
 **hands\-on role** 
 for someone who enjoys building systems from the ground up and can independently manage recruitment, employee operations, payroll coordination and HR policies.
   




 Roles \& Responsibilities
   

 Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition
 * Own the end\-to\-end recruitment process across the organization.
* Understand hiring requirements from founders and department heads and create effective JDs.
* Source candidates through LinkedIn, job portals, referrals and other channels.
* Screen candidates, conduct initial HR interviews and coordinate subsequent interview rounds.
* Manage salary discussions, offer letters and joining formalities.
* Maintain an organized recruitment pipeline and ensure positions are closed within agreed timelines.
* Build and maintain a strong candidate database for future hiring requirements.


 HR Operations
 * Manage the complete employee lifecycle — onboarding to exit.
* Maintain employee records, documentation and HR databases.
* Manage attendance, leaves, working hours and employee records.
* Handle day\-to\-day employee queries and HR\-related concerns.
* Coordinate employee onboarding, probation confirmations and exits.
* Ensure HR processes are followed consistently across the organization.


 Payroll \& Compensation
 * Manage monthly payroll inputs and coordinate with the finance/accounting team for salary processing.
* Maintain accurate records of salaries, incentives, deductions, advances and reimbursements.
* Track employee attendance and leave data for payroll.
* Coordinate payslips and other employee compensation documentation.
* Ensure payroll is processed accurately and on time every month.


 HR Policies \& Compliance
 * Develop, implement and maintain company HR policies and processes.
* Manage policies related to attendance, leave, notice periods, probation, work\-from\-home, code of conduct and disciplinary procedures.
* Ensure employees understand and follow company policies.
* Maintain proper HR documentation and records.
* Work with external professionals/consultants where required for statutory HR compliance.


 Performance \& People Management
 * Establish and manage employee performance review processes.
* Track probation periods and performance evaluations.
* Work with managers to define employee KPIs and expectations.
* Support performance improvement processes where required.
* Help build a culture of accountability, ownership and high performance.


 Employee Experience
 * Be the primary HR point of contact for employees.
* Address employee concerns and workplace issues professionally.
* Help build a positive, transparent and professional work environment.
* Organize employee engagement initiatives and internal activities.
* Continuously improve HR processes as the company grows.


 What We're Looking For
 * **2–5 years of experience** 
 in HR, HR Operations or HR Generalist roles.
* Experience in a startup, D2C, e\-commerce, fashion, retail or other fast\-growing company is a requirement.
* Strong understanding of recruitment and employee lifecycle management.
* Experience managing payroll inputs and attendance/leave systems.
* Strong knowledge of HR policies and processes.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong organizational and documentation skills.
* Ability to handle confidential employee information responsibly.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced startup environment.
* Strong ownership — you should be comfortable taking a problem and figuring out how to solve it independently.



  




 The Kind of Person We're Looking For
 
 We're looking for someone who is
 **hands\-on, organized, proactive and people\-oriented** 
 .
 



 You should be someone who doesn't wait to be told what to do — if you notice that a process is broken, you should be comfortable identifying the problem and building a better system.
 



 This role will have significant ownership and direct interaction with the founders, making it an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to
 **build and lead the HR function of a growing company.**



 Why Join Evara?
 * Work directly with the founders and leadership team.
* Own and build the HR function from the ground up.
* High level of responsibility and autonomy.
* Opportunity to grow with a rapidly scaling consumer brand.
* Be part of a young, ambitious and entrepreneurial team.



  





**If you're excited about building people, processes and culture at a growing company, we'd love to hear from you.**

**Job Summary**
 Workplace Operations is responsible for overseeing the day\-to\-day management of integrated facilities across assigned locations, ensuring seamless delivery of services aligned with business needs, compliance requirements, and corporate standards. The role involves managing vendor performance, engineering services, statutory compliance, real estate coordination, audits, and stakeholder engagement. The candidate will also lead workplace experience initiatives, support sustainability and EHS goals, drive team development, and ensure smooth operations during business continuity or crisis situations. The role is instrumental in creating a productive, safe, and engaging workplace environment that enhances employee experience and supports business continuity. A strong focus on service quality, operational efficiency, and client satisfaction is essential.
   

  

**Role And Responsibilities**
**Integrated Facility management**
* Plan, manage, and oversee day\-to\-day workplace operations for assigned locations.
* Conduct daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly service reviews with service partner teams. Ensure delivery of daily onsite facility management services including asset management, engineering, building maintenance, cleaning, office services, mail delivery, logistics and storage services.
* Ensure workplace operations meet or exceed service delivery and corporate standards in line with global/local policies.
* Drive the Service Partner to execute the deliverables as per the agreed scope of works and review the performance as per schedule.
* Manage operating and capital budgets in coordination with site operations and commercial teams for geography or location.
* Govern Service delivery partner and vendor performance using SLAs, KPIs, OLAs, and other tracking mechanisms.
* Maintain high service quality by identifying weak areas and implementing corrective actions.
* Monitor and document MIS/reporting processes, including weekly/fortnightly/monthly/ quarterly calendars.
* Deploy global changes to policies, operating models, and best practices.
* Maintain a healthy working environment, and foster employee productivity by ensuring a functional, safe, and engaging workplace.


**Engineering and Technical Services**
* Oversee engineering infrastructure and keep a track of service partners performance by reviewing the uptime of all engineering assets and performance as per agreed OLA’s.
* Collaborate on R\&M planning, and drive OPEX/CAPEX initiatives aligned with sustainability and safety. Leverage tools to improve quality of services, including office meters, sensors and SLA tracking.
* Track and manage M \& E Opex and Capex budgets for engineering services efficiently.
* Support implementation of sustainability and energy efficiency initiatives.


**Statutory Compliance and Risks**
* Ensure compliance with all statutory norms and third\-party vendor (TPV) legal requirements.
* Liaise with all stakeholders/teams who are part of the process: Legal, HR, TPV, AEE, Contract Management, and Commercial teams to fulfil obligations.
* Track license renewals (e.g. lifts, fire NOCs, building safety, water quality, etc.).
* Maintain documentation for health, safety, and environment\-related regulations.
* Lead responses to all audits—internal, external, client, statutory, and process audits covering the workplace operations.


**Corporate Real Estate (CRE)**
* Engage with landlords on all operational issues and lease terms on a monthly basis.
* Ensure all contractual obligations are being fulfilled by both parties.
* Escalate RE MSA or CAM related issues or violations to CRE leads.
* Support site selection and site disposition and extend all necessary support to Workplace leads , CRE POC, Controllership and Procurement, including risk\-free handovers and formal process closure.
* Coordinate with CRE, procurement, and finance during acquisition/disposition.


**Workplace Governance and Client Relationship Management**
* Conduct structured CRM connects with key business stakeholders (DU Leads, MDs, SDLs, etc.).
* Present KPI delivery metrics and track escalation resolution within a reasonable time frame (SNOW, M \& E, Events, Travel, etc.).
* Monitor and drive monthly client engagement activities (townhalls, bay walks, FGDs).
* Maintain strong client satisfaction by acting on feedback and enabling resolution of workplace issues.


**Security, EHS, and Business Continuity**
* Oversee physical and electronic security controls, including CCTV, access controls, and fire safety.
* Lead response efforts during BCP or crisis events and participate in LMT calls.
* Ensure site compliance with EHS protocols and wellness standards.
* Supervise wellness facilities such as gyms, wellness rooms, ambulance support, etc.


**Cafeteria Management**
* Oversee aggregator managed cafeteria operations and ensure compliance to the SLAs. Oversee vendor selection, hygiene and sanitation standards, and quality of food and ensure adherence to EHS and GAP standards, and other statutory compliance.
* Lead Food Committee Reviews and ensure feedback is acted upon by the vendor .
* Oversee licenses and documentation for food services.


**Team Management**
* Right\-size direct and extended vendor teams; ensure role clarity and workload balance.
* Ensure timely completion of mandatory training programs for all personnel, both direct and TPV service partner teams.
* Deliver feedback and performance reviews to the team members and drive team engagement activities.
* Promote a culture of innovation and employee well\-being.


**Stakeholder Engagement \& Special Events**
* Extend support for high\-profile visits, including global leaders and clients.
* Participate in showcasing workplace capabilities during such events.
* Liaise with SMT, P\+ teams, and central/managed services (Events, CPSM, Travel) to ensure operational harmony.


**Projects and Transitions**
* Oversee seamless handover of newly completed WP projects into operations.
* Actively contribute during transition stages to ensure business readiness.


**Professional \& Technical Skills**
* Strong leadership and team management skills with a track record of driving operational excellence.
* Strong organisational and planning skills with attention to detail.
* Proven experience in managing multi\-disciplinary teams and external stakeholders.
* Effective communication (English, Hindi, and preferably Marathi) and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent problem\-solving, decision\-making, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong analytical and reporting abilities (MIS, KPIs, OLAs).
* Crisis management and business continuity planning (BCP) experience.
* Change management and adaptability to global process changes.
* Strong presentation and documentation skills.
* Proficient in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, word), working knowledge of Power BI and Power Apps preferred.


**Additional Information:**
* The ideal candidate should be a person of high integrity and moral values with strong leadership skills.
* This position is based out of NCR offices.

Role Summary
 
 ICCS is looking for a General Manager / AVP – Employee Relations \& Retention to own attrition as a business number across ICCS's approximately 5,000\-employee, 10\+ site PAN India footprint, and to run the compliance\-first ER case function that supports it. In a domestic BPO, attrition is the single largest controllable cost driver — this role exists to move that number, not merely to administer grievance and disciplinary process around it. It is for a seasoned ER / attrition leader who has run a high\-volume ER function inside a BPO / ITES / contact\-centre environment — grievance handling, disciplinary process and domestic enquiries, POSH compliance — and has personally owned and moved an attrition number at scale.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 
**1\. Attrition Ownership \& Retention Strategy** 




 •    Own the PAN India attrition target; publish and defend attrition performance to the CEO's office monthly.
 



 •    Design and run retention programmes targeted at the 0–90 day window, where most frontline attrition occurs.
 



 •    Build exit analytics — reason codes, tenure cohorts, site and process\-level patterns — and convert them into operational interventions, not just engagement activity.
 



 •    Partner with Operations leadership so retention actions land with team leaders, not only with HR.
 



**2\. PAN India ER Strategy \& Governance** 




 •    Own the ER framework end\-to\-end for all ICCS centres (Noida, Mumbai, Bangalore, Chennai and any new sites), ensuring consistent grievance redressal, disciplinary process and investigation protocols.
 



 •    Own ER case TAT and SLA commitments against every open case, and personally intervene on high\-risk or aging matters.
 



 •    Build and standardise ER policies, SOPs and escalation matrices consistently across all sites and processes.
 



**3\. Grievance Handling \& Investigations** 




 •    Lead or oversee investigations into employee complaints — misconduct, harassment, policy violations — ensuring principles of natural justice are followed throughout.
 



 •    Conduct or supervise disciplinary hearings and domestic enquiries, working closely with site HR and Operations.
 



 •    Ensure fair, prompt and confidential handling of every case, with documentation that stands up to audit and legal scrutiny.
 



**4\. Statutory Compliance \& POSH** 




 •    Own POSH compliance PAN India — constitution and functioning of Internal Committees (IC) at every location, awareness sessions, and timely closure of complaints within statutory timelines.
 



 •    Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws — Industrial Employment (Standing Orders) Act, Shops \& Establishments Act, Contract Labour Act, and other state\-specific regulations across all centres.
 



 •    Liaise with legal counsel on ER matters that carry litigation or regulatory risk.
 



**5\. Employee Engagement \& Listening** 




 •    Run skip\-level connects, engagement surveys and floor\-level listening mechanisms, particularly at frontline/production level.
 



 •    Analyse exit interview and case data to identify ER\-linked attrition drivers and recommend systemic fixes to Operations and HR leadership.
 



**6\. Stakeholder \& Team Management** 




 •    Manage works/grievance committees as required under Standing Orders, and act as the primary liaison between employees, Operations leadership and HR on sensitive matters.
 



 •    Partner closely with Operations, Legal and Compliance teams on high\-risk or reputationally sensitive cases.
 



 •    Build, mentor and manage a PAN India ER team of 8–10 across locations — setting case\-quality, TAT and attrition\-outcome standards.
 



**7\. Reporting \& Governance** 




 •    Own the ER and attrition dashboard and report monthly on attrition performance, case volumes, TAT, closure rates and POSH compliance status to the CEO's office and Head – HR.
 



 •    Maintain complete case documentation and ensure audit\-readiness across all centres at all times.
 



  




 Desired Candidate Profile
 
**Experience \& Background** 




 •    15\+ years in Employee Relations / Industrial Relations, with direct ownership of an attrition number — not case management alone.
 



 •    Has owned an attrition number across a workforce of 3,000 or more in a BPO or similar high\-churn environment, with a measurable, personally\-driven reduction backed by before\-and\-after figures.
 



 •    Mandatory: current or recent experience within the BPO / ITES / Contact Centre / Shared Services industry, with direct ER exposure in a high\-volume, frontline environment.
 



 •    Managed a PAN India, multi\-location ER team of 8 or more (minimum 3–4 locations), ideally including Noida/Delhi\-NCR, Mumbai, Bengaluru and Chennai.
 



 •    Hands\-on experience conducting domestic enquiries and POSH investigations, from complaint intake through to closure.
 



 •    Working knowledge of applicable labour laws — Industrial Employment (Standing Orders) Act, Shops \& Establishments Act, POSH Act, Contract Labour Act and related state regulations, including contract labour compliance.
 



 •    Experience partnering with Legal and Operations leadership on high\-risk or litigation\-prone cases.
 



**Preferred** 




 •    Experience in a unionised or union\-attempt environment.
 



 •    Exposure to predictive attrition analytics.
 



**Not a Fit** 




 •    Generalist HRBPs who have supported attrition initiatives without owning the number.
 



 •    Corporate or white\-collar ER backgrounds with no frontline, high\-churn exposure.
 



 •    Candidates who describe retention purely as engagement activity — events, celebrations, rewards — with no analytical basis.
 



**Education** 




 •    Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM in HR preferred.
 



**Key Skills \& Competencies** 




 •    Ownership of an attrition number as a business metric, backed by data.
 



 •    Strong working knowledge of labour law and statutory compliance.
 



 •    Excellent investigation, case\-management and documentation skills.
 



 •    Stakeholder management across Operations, Legal and employees at all levels.
 



 •    High emotional intelligence, discretion and conflict\-resolution ability.
 



 •    Team building and people leadership across a distributed, PAN India team.
